g_policy.reason: The pop-up is opt-in and the offer copy states the reward (30 minutes with no sponsored stories). Declining changes nothing, and the 'if the ad fails' field covers both a game that isn't ready and a play that isn't confirmed.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 30 minutes of hidden sponsored cards, which has no cash value and can't be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is the reader being halfway through an article on s02, an app event with no chat content involved.

g_no_free_removal.reason: Nothing free is removed or capped. The proposal only adds a temporary way to hide sponsored cards, and 'removes nothing free' is yes.

g_brand_safety.reason: The offer is a pop-up over the article screen s02, which is rated safe. It is not a chat screen and is not placed in or next to unsafe or unknown content.

c1_revealed_value.reason: As a product change, it adds ad-free time that the player uses in the observed 'Read a story' flow (f01), so the reward goes to the player in a core flow.

c2_evidence.reason: The 'what makes it work here' field states as plain fact that 'The app has no paywall, limit, or currency' and that the sponsored cards are the only friction. The model only records that none was seen on the home feed, and lists the Inbox as blocked, so this is an unobserved claim worded as fact about the whole app.

c3_spares_payers.reason: The product model shows no paid plan, so there are no paying users to spare.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward expires after 30 minutes, there is no subscription to protect, and it takes nothing from other users or creators.

c5_moment.reason: The trigger is 'halfway through an article', where the pop-up interrupts reading. That is not a limit hit, a locked item tapped, or a finished action, and it is not a persistent surface the user chooses to open.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn unit and the reward is granted only once the play is confirmed. The trigger, reaching the midpoint of an article, is an event the app can detect.

c7_specific.reason: It names specific elements of this app: the Taboola sponsored cards in the home feed (s01.e44) and in articles (s02.e13), and the s02 article reader.

other_concern: The claim that hiding the cards costs little revenue is a prediction, not a fact. Reward size and revenue impact are untested, since fill is variable.
